title: Wrong Layout Input
description: Catches text typed with the wrong keyboard layout ("ghbdtn" meant "привет", "руддщ" meant "hello", plus Hebrew, Greek and Hindi InScript) by scoring it against letter-pair models of each language and spellings no real word has, then offers the retyped text as a one-tap fix with undo, leaving names, acronyms, links and code alone.
stops: Text typed in the wrong keyboard layout
